mapper.select: INSERT INTO alphafrog_agent_run_service_lease (run_id, owner_instance_id, fencing_token, acquired_at, renewed_at, expires_at) SELECT #{runId}, #{owner}, 1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + #{ttlMillis} * INTERVAL '1 millisecond' WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM alphafrog_agent_run r WHERE r.id = #{runId}) ON CONFLICT (run_id) DO UPDATE SET fencing_token = CASE WHEN alphafrog_agent_run_service_lease.owner_instance_id = EXCLUDED.owner_instance_id THEN alphafrog_agent_run_service_lease.fencing_token ELSE alphafrog_agent_run_service_lease.fencing_token + 1 END, owner_instance_id = EXCLUDED.owner_instance_id, renewed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at WHERE alphafrog_agent_run_service_lease.expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP OR alphafrog_agent_run_service_lease.owner_instance_id = EXCLUDED.owner_instance_id RETURNING run_id, owner_instance_id, fencing_token, acquired_at, renewed_at, expires_at
mapper.update: UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_service_lease l SET renewed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, expires_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + #{ttlMillis} * INTERVAL '1 millisecond' WHERE l.owner_instance_id = #{owner} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM alphafrog_agent_run r WHERE r.id = l.run_id AND r.status IN ())
mapper.select: SELECT l.run_id, l.owner_instance_id, l.fencing_token, l.acquired_at, l.renewed_at, l.expires_at FROM alphafrog_agent_run_service_lease l JOIN alphafrog_agent_run r ON r.id = l.run_id WHERE l.owner_instance_id = #{owner} AND r.status IN () ORDER BY l.acquired_at, l.run_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT l.run_id, l.owner_instance_id, l.fencing_token, l.acquired_at, l.renewed_at, l.expires_at FROM alphafrog_agent_run_service_lease l JOIN alphafrog_agent_run r ON r.id = l.run_id WHERE l.expires_at <= #{now} AND r.status IN () ORDER BY l.expires_at, l.run_id LIMIT #{limit}
